items.question: who do I call in an emergency on campus
items.answer: In an emergency on campus you should call 999 and also the Campus Support team by dialing 2222 on any University phone (or +44 (0)151 794 2222 from a personal mobile).

claims.claim: In an emergency on campus you should call 999
In an emergency on campus you should also call the Campus Support team
You can dial 2222 on any University phone to reach Campus Support
You can dial +44 (0)151 794 2222 from a personal mobile to reach Campus Support

judge.note: The answer accurately reflects the emergency contact information provided in the cited passages and matches the reference evidence.

items.question: do I need a TV licence to watch TV in my room
items.evidence: it is a legal requirement to obtain a television licence
items.answer: Yes, you must obtain a television licence to watch TV in your university bedroom or off‑campus room, and failure to do so can lead to a fine of up to £1,000. [1]

claims.claim: You must obtain a television licence to watch TV in your university bedroom or off-campus room.
Failure to do so can lead to a fine of up to £1,000.

judge.note: The answer accurately reflects the legal requirement and penalty stated in the cited passage.

items.question: my landlord wants proof I'm a student so I don't pay council tax
items.answer: You can obtain a Council Tax Student Certificate by requesting it online through the Liverpool Life portal; it will be emailed to your university account within three working days, which you can then give to your landlord as proof of full‑time student status for council tax exemption [1].

You can give the certificate to your landlord as proof of full-time student status for council tax exemption.
